name: shadowstrike-prepare-x-zero-refused-then-x-2
notes: Shadowstrike (o191zv86la, UMBRA ATTACK, reserve 2, printed power 4): "Prepare X. X can't be 0. Shadowstrike gets +X POWER. [Class Bonus] If Shadowstrike was prepared, it has unblockable." Player 2's champion is Tristan, Shadowdancer (ASSASSIN, UMBRA); player 1 controls a Swift Recruit (Intercept) so blockability is observable. Shadowstrike is played for real (10002 FSM play + two reserve payments, 100 answers) and attacks player 1's champion. Champion has 3 counters; after YES the X prompt is answered 0 ("X can't be 0") and then 9 (more than the 3 counters) -- both are refused, pay nothing and re-ask (per-step state dump: NUMBERCHOOSE 1|3 is still the head of the queue after each) -- and then X=2 is accepted: 2 counters removed, POWER 6, 6 damage, unblockable. Fixed in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php: a hand-authored $cardActivatedAbilities['o191zv86la:0'] queues a YES/NO 'Pay Prepare X?' then (on YES) a NUMBERCHOOSE for X in 1..preparation counters, removes X counters, sets wasPrepared=YES (GA_TagPreparedAttack then tags the intent PREPARED) and adds the 'o191zv86la_POWER_<X>' TurnEffect that ObjectCurrentPower() already read.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] If Shadowstrike was prepared, it has unblockable.
